the use of colchicine to induce polyploids in V. narbonensis is feasible and that tetraploids obtained from this method have a high potential to improve the yield of the crop.

the use of a combination of colchicine and a pregerminated seed treatment resulted in the highest percentage of tetraploid plants.

the production of Vicia narbonenis tetraploids and the cytogenetic study of these plants.

the polyploid V. narbonensis plants are characterized by a large size, a large number of chloroplasts per stomata, a large number and size of stomata, a high pollen fertility and a tetrahedral pollen grain shape.
